stages.headline: A cylinder is obtained by rotating a rectangle about one of its sides; it has two equal disc bases and a lateral surface.
stages.headlineEnglish: A cylinder is obtained by rotating a rectangle about one of its sides; it has two equal disc bases and a lateral surface.

stages.headline: The axial section of a cylinder is a rectangle with sides 2r and h.
stages.headlineEnglish: The axial section of a cylinder is a rectangle with sides 2r and h.

stages.headline: Examples: a tin can, a pipe, a pencil.
